evidence.quote: Participants noted that a highly accommodative stance of monetary policy would likely be needed for some time to achieve the 2 percent inflation objective over the longer run.

over coming months it would be appropriate for the Federal Reserve to increase its holdings of Treasury securities and agency MBS and agency CMBS at least at the current pace to sustain smooth market functioning
the overall effect of the outbreak on prices was seen as disinflationary

A number of participants judged that there was a substantial likelihood of additional waves of outbreaks, which, in some scenarios, could result in further economic disruptions and possibly a protracted period of reduced economic activity.
Participants agreed that the data for the second quarter would likely show the largest decline in economic activity in post–World War II history.
most participants commented that the Committee should communicate a more explicit form of forward guidance for the path of the federal funds rate

parsed.rationale: The minutes describe rates held at the ELB until the economy recovers, continued asset purchases at least at the current pace, disinflationary pressures, severe weakness and downside risks, along with a push toward more explicit accommodative guidance. The net signal is strongly dovish.
